_comment: Per-vehicle site values for 06-deploy-onboard-hmi.ps1. Copy to site-<alias>.json, fill in, commit. None of these are secrets -- vehicleKey is already in ControlServer's appsettings.json, and the credential and operator id come from the DPAPI store instead. The onboardInstanceId must stay stable for the life of the vehicle: the server treats a new one as a different onboard instance.
